sentences.en: "Sorry we were such a long time," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 对不起我们是这样的一个长的时间， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "There was a lot of washing up to do." "Never mind," Laughed Anneena.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个许多的洗向上到做。 从不头脑， 说 Trudy。 从不头脑， 笑 Anneena。

sentences.en: "The time just flew by."
sentences.zh: 这时间刚刚飞由。

sentences.en: "And it wasn't just the time that flew," joked Nadim.
sentences.zh: 和它不是刚刚这时间那个飞， 笑话 Nadim。
